patterns: APPSC asks work-author or work-theme recall: Gabbilam's bat messenger (Jashuva), Veyi Padagalu -> Sahasraphan (PVNR), Nallapoddu (Gogu Syamala), Jakkadona.
Distractor sets are other famous Telugu titles (Tulasidalam, Mahaprasthanam, Vennello Aadapilla).
Movement chronology (1965 Digambara, 1970 Virasam) and Telugu Jnanpith winners are likely single-fact items.
App MCQs follow the same work-author pattern; pen-name and anthology items are deeper than PYQs but sound.
